START TRANSACTION;

insert into tb_gastos_limites(id_cliente, periodo, valor_limite, dt_inicio, dt_fim, renova_automatico, dt_cadastro, status, porcentagem_alerta)
select id_cliente, 
       periodo, 
       valor_limite,
       DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW()), 
       DATE_TRUNC('day',CURRENT_DATE + (dt_fim - dt_inicio)) dt_fim, 
       renova_automatico, 
       now(), 
       'A' status,
       porcentagem_alerta,
  from tb_gastos_limites A
 where a.status = 'A'
   and a.renova_automatico = 'S'
   and DATE_TRUNC('day', dt_fim) < DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW());

update tb_gastos_limites
   set status = 'D'
 where status = 'A'
   and DATE_TRUNC('day', dt_fim) < DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW());

COMMIT;
